title: Which Countries Survive? 🌍 Marble Elimination · Round 1 Heat 2/7
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 1 · Heat 2/7: 27 countries race through 3 stages — only 14 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Afghanistan, Antigua and Barbuda, Azerbaijan, Bahamas, Brunei, Bulgaria, Chad, China, Cyprus, Eswatini, Fiji, Gabon, Iran, Ireland, Lebanon, Libya, Mexico, Mongolia, Papua New Guinea, Romania, Rwanda, Senegal, Seychelles, Sweden, Tonga, USA, Venezuela.

Countries still in the game before this race: 176 of 193.
Next race: Round 1 · Heat 3/7. Grand Final: Nov 9.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. 3 new races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
